partial_credit.interpretation: Observed valid IDs on usable returned bylines, including incomplete-ID papers. This does not reconstruct missing people. Allocated credit per ID is not P/A; unallocated credit is not assigned to an artificial author.

orcid_on_paired_papers.interpretation: Source-recorded ORCID strings; neither rate is an adjudicated split rate or a population bound. Repeated observation changes the opportunity to detect a mapping to several IDs.
